name: Launcher Labs
long_description: Launcher Labs made consumer crypto apps, including Launchcaster (acq by Orange DAO), a leading community for launching and discovering crypto projects; Frameboard, a visual curation app and protocol; Launcher Actions, a smart contract mini-app platform; and Maindrop, a Venmo for NFTs.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Working on something new in AI. 

Previously, I founded Launcher Labs, a YC W21 and a16zcrypto-backed company. Before that, I founded Homeward.io (acquired by Keller Williams), Fohandboh (acquired by JobGet), and a few other things.

I live in Austin, TX, with my wife and two children, whom we homeschool. When I'm not working or hanging out with my family, I love trail running, hiking, and all things Texas.

launches.title: Launchcaster.xyz
launches.tagline: Product Hunt of Web3. Built on Farcaster.
launches.body:
Launchcaster is a place for discovering and launching new web3 projects. Think “Product Hunt or Launch YC of Web3.” We struggled to find a good channel for launching our Web3 products … so we built one!

### How it works

1. Anyone can see or vote on launches (after connecting wallet)
2. Submit a launch by replying to or starting a [Farcaster](https://www.farcaster.xyz/) post with “@launch”
3. The launch bot creates the post and replies with a link
